_help: Day 2, room 6: the shed, 'Henri's blue shed' (1960-1962). The year on the paint pot; string and a magnet make a fishing magnet for the jar on the shelf; the waves and stars on Margot's cradle. See docs/STORY.md.

locks._why: The side door key was in the flower cart's drawer.
hints: The side way round is locked.
The key from the flower cart's drawer opens the side door.
Select the brass key, then tap the side door.

locks._why: Henri wrote on the pot when he finished and put his brushes in his right-hand drawer; the pot on the pegboard says 1961.
hints: Henri wrote something down when the blue was finished.
The paint pot on the pegboard belongs to Henri's right-hand drawer.

locks._why: Something heavy rolled under the workbench; Chloé brings it out.
hints: Tap Chloé, then tap under the workbench.

locks._why: The jar on the high shelf is too narrow for a hand: a magnet on a string reaches in.
hints: Something's at the bottom of a jar too narrow for your hand.
String and a magnet together could fish it out of the jar on the shelf.
Combine the string and the magnet, select the fishing magnet, then tap the jar on the shelf.

locks._why: A wave for every month they waited for Margot (9) and a star for each of the three of them (3); 'so could the little cart by the door'.
hints: How long do you wait for a baby? And how many were they?
The cradle memory belongs to the flower cart's drawer.

clues.text: Next to the brushes on the pegboard, an old paint pot with a crust of blue on the lid: SEA BLUE · 1961 · H.
